we see your event as more than a reflection of you.
it is you. just more so.
we are inspired by the doctrine of original thought.
we pay attention to detail.
we live for beauty.
we support the politics of chintz. and the etiquette of mylar.
we create tents made of satin. and evenings made of fun.
we believe in happy endings.
we are Rafanelli Events.
and the best event we've ever done is going to be yours.
Capabilities Rafanelli Events is an award-winning event company with a proven track record of producing breathtaking events for our clients. Using a combination of creativity, service, design and production, we work closely with all clients to create event concepts and designs that truly represent their unique goals and objectives.
Rafanelli Events has spent more than fifteen years building strong relationships with the best companies across the country and we consistently provide our clients with the most up-to-date technologies and innovations. Our success is built on listening to, respecting, understanding and complementing some of the
most successful people, companies and brands in the world.
Rafanelli Team Twenty-five talented, creative and dedicated professionals Our event teams each consist of CEO Bryan Rafanelli, Creative Director Billy Evers, an Event Producer and a Production Manager.

ON-SITE MANAGEMENT PHOTOGRAPHY PRINT COLLATERAL RAFFLES Bryan Rafanelli Biography "If party planning is a fine art, then consider Bryan Rafanelli a virtuoso" WCVB-TV Boston "The event planner of the year" Town & Country Bryan Rafanelli's exquisite sense of style, attention to detail and ability to transform clients'
visions into unforgettable celebrations have made him a go-to planner for the nation's most exclusive and high-profile events. He has produced it all, from elaborate fairytale-themed fundraising galas for Massachusetts General Hospital for Children to Chelsea Clinton's "wedding of the decade" to State Dinners hosted by President Barack Obama and First Lady Michelle
Obama.
Rafanelli and his firm, Rafanelli Events, have a simple philosophy: every event is a unique creative challenge deserving of a one-of-a-kind approach. "My team listens to what you're imagining and then comes back with an idea you never expected," he says. "We hone in on every last detail so we can always deliver clients the highest level of service."
The media has taken notice. A recent feature in OUT magazine reads, "For a flawlessly executed affair to remember, a behind-the-scenes mastermind juggles the details. If you're lucky, that person will be event planner Bryan Rafanelli." And the headline of a recent New York Times profile –For Wedding Planner, Obsession with Privacy– reinforces that Rafanelli is tight-lipped no
matter whom the client is, letting his work speak for itself.
Rafanelli has been named "Man of the Moment" by Town & Country (2010), a 2011 "Innovator" and "Event Producer of the Year" by BizBash, one of OUT magazine's "100 Most Compelling People in 2010", a "Trendsetter of the Year" by Modern Bride, a "40 Under 40" by the Boston Business Journal and "Best in Boston" eight years running by Boston magazine. His events have
been highlighted in: The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, People, New York, CBSNews.com, VanityFair.com, NewYorker.com and more. Rafanelli has also appeared as an industry expert on regional and national television programs including: "The Martha Stewart Show", ABC's "Good Morning America", NBC's "The Today Show" and as a
regular contributor on New England Cable News' "Morning Show." Rafanelli grew up in a large Rhode Island family, his mother always finding reason to throw parties for the people she loved. "The sense of community and of bringing people together to have good time just for 'good time's sake' has always been inside me," he says. He launched
Rafanelli Events in 1996 as a three-person operation executing only a handful of events a year. It has quickly evolved into a full-service event design, strategy, planning and production company with more than 100 events annually in venues around the world. Headquartered in Boston, Rafanelli Events also has offices in New York City, Washington, DC and Palm Beach.

Billy Evers Biography In the eyes of Billy Evers, inspiration is everywhere. Art, theater, fashion and music are all fair game; they're the moving parts of what makes an event come together as a whole. As creative director at Rafanelli Events, Billy takes each occasion that he plans and carefully balances the details. Whether he's dreaming up a wedding in Maine or a
multi-million dollar hospital fundraiser, his role is to create, to imagine and to edit, from the very first client interaction until the final guest goes home. "The events we create are always evolving," Billy says. "The tweaking, the adding, the making sure everything's precise—it's something I pride our company on. We're always perfecting what we do."
Billy first teamed up with Bryan Rafanelli 10 years ago, only a few years after the company's inception in 1996. "I was living in New York, but would come to Boston socially," Billy says. "Bryan asked me to help out and things literally went from zero to 100 in six weeks. Before I knew it, I was living here, an extremely active member of
Bryan's growing team." Billy's background lends itself well to his role at Rafanelli. Prior to joining Bryan's team, he worked for a number of years in New York, running a high-end fashion boutique on Madison Avenue. This experience allowed him to travel the world, exposing him to an endless range of arts and culture. "All of it, together, has become the perfect resume for
what I do now," Billy says. "When I see a room, I see it in a theatrical way. I draw from my love of film, my reservoir of experience in art and fashion, my passion for music." All of these influences play an invaluable role in Billy's creative process. "I get involved with film, photography, fabric, accessories, lighting, the smell of a place—the entire
sensory experience," he says. But beyond the individual details, Billy is responsible for dreaming up a concept. "Rafanelli is unique in terms of how broad our range is and what we're capable of doing," he says. "We're so not about 'just a party'. What we're doing is a whole new style of event. Concepting and branding meet smart design, value and
integrity. I love the challenge of it all."
